title: loopl-train conversation record
description: One line of a loopl-train jsonl shard. Mirrors src/loopl_train/common.py::Record and the structural rules in validate.check. Produced by the loopl-train pipeline (families a–h) AND by the loopl iOS app's 'Share to Hugging Face' export (family u, gen.generator = loopl-app/<version>). Both repos test against this file: loopl-train tests/test_schema.py, loopl Tests/LooplTests/ConversationExportTests.swift. Version 1.0.0.

id.description: <family>-<10 hex> for generated rows; the app uses u-<10 hex of sha256(thread id)>.

family.description: a strands-knowledge · b strands-code · c agent-trajectory · d owner-projects · e robots · f loopl-self · g identity-honesty · h vision · u conversations shared from the loopl app

messages.description: HF chat format as consumed by Qwen3.5's template. messages[0] is the loopl system turn (data/system/loopl.md, verbatim); the last message is a plain assistant answer (no tool_calls); every tool_call id has exactly one tool message with that tool_call_id after it.

tools.description: OpenAI function specs the model was OFFERED in this conversation (families c and u). Each assistant tool_call must name one of them.

source.description: Repository references that ground the sample. Empty for trajectories (c) and app conversations (u).

images.description: Image files referenced by {"type":"image"} parts, in order, as paths RELATIVE TO THE DATASET REPO ROOT (images/<sha256-prefix>.<png|jpg>). Count must equal the number of image parts in messages.

critic.description: Second-agent review for generated rows (score 1–5; only ≥ 4 are kept by the pipeline). Absent for app-shared rows — the person sharing is the reviewer.

gen.description: Provenance. Pipeline rows: model, ts, generator, system_version, … App rows: generator 'loopl-app/<app version>', model = ModelSpec.id that produced the assistant turns, ts (ISO-8601), system_version (the loopl.md version embedded), platform, thread (opaque id), redaction flags.

content.description: A string, or (user turns of vision rows) a list of parts: {"type":"image"} then {"type":"text","text":…}.

tool_calls.description: Assistant only. arguments is an OBJECT (Qwen's template tojson()s it), never a string.

tool_call_id.description: tool role only — the id of the assistant tool_call this result answers.
